description: Fresh hosted compilation of the reviewed Companion source with a disposable signing key; no installable artifact or signing credentials retained.
extraction: verification.json printed in the completed job log; artifact metadata and SHA-256 independently matched to the upload log
checks: Reviewed upstream source commit and applied patch receipt
Pre- and post-build tracked source commit/tree/status and hidden-index checks
APK package, version code, clean patched version name and non-debuggable manifest
Independent apksigner verification against the fresh test key's DER certificate
Signed APK SHA-256 equals build receipt
Normal deterministic CI, including real-Git hidden-index regressions
limitations: The signer is disposable and is not a production or official microG signing identity.
The signed APK and private credentials were removed by the job and were not uploaded.
This build does not establish installed-package migration, device boot, ART verification, restricted spoofing, microG self-check or live billing acceptance.
Mutable upstream dependency repositories mean this is not a claim of a hermetic or bit-for-bit reproducible APK.
